desc: Ideation: reduce the process to noncrossing matching and prove the even-segment half-sum upper bound is achievable.
Implement the complete Python solution using the two-heap half-difference method to compute prefix and suffix even-segment values, then combine them for odd N or output the full value for even N.
Validate the approach against the provided samples and edge cases, confirming parity, prefix/suffix indexing, and heap maintenance are correct.
